answer: Because the timing is logged against the zephyr challenge, the canyon audit can replay the plume history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm thus has to pad 96 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which burns the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 168 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
